title: Fern and the Silent Seed Bells
logline: When the forest's morning bells are tangled silent, Fern and Pipkin use what each can see and reach to wake the day.

phrases.speaker: Narrator
phrases.text: In Lanternleaf Forest, morning began with seed bells.

readingUnits.speaker: Narrator

phrases.speaker: Narrator

phrases.text: The breeze rushed in. The seed bells bobbed and chimed—one, two, three!
